unresolved_gaps: The reviewed evidence does not independently establish the claimed reputational benefit from Musk attributable specifically to nonprofit commitments.
The records support recruiting appeal, tax exemption, and donations, but do not conclusively establish every asserted connection between those benefits and nonprofit promises.
The financial component supplies no accounting basis; under the money-claim rules it cannot receive a supported or contradicted score.
